outputs.location: Section titled "Data availability" (immediately after Statistical analysis / at the end of Methods)
outputs.issues: The DAS is present but not in the required format. Problems: (1) Entries are sentences, not a bullet list with one dataset per bullet. (2) Only the RNA‑seq dataset has an accession (S‑BSST2081) but no repository URL or DOI/resolvable link is provided. (3) Other data are described vaguely (“source data are included in this published article” and “available from the corresponding authors upon reasonable request”) without per‑dataset repository/accession/link details. (4) Does not list data type + repository + accession + resolvable link for each dataset as required.
